title: In This Town Every Thank You Costs a Gold BLOCK
description:
In this town, every favour you owe sits on your head as a little gold block. Say thanks and it lands. Do one back and it drops off. My head has always been bare.

My cousin Ilan has the tallest stack in town, and this summer it won't stop growing. People whisper that he owes everyone. And on my empty half of our old stone seat, something has started sitting.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Who do you never say thanks to?
